From: Elena Park <elena@cobalthealth.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverable-linked upgrade request

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re seeing the workload trend up faster than planned and need to add committed capacity mid-contract. Our preferred approach would be an uplift tied to a launch milestone: if we commit to an additional 250k tokens/month for the next 9 months (to support the new clinical summarization pipeline) and pay up front for Q3/Q4 usage, we’re asking for a deliverable-linked discount (i.e., X% off list while we roll out and achieve the milestone).

A few asks from our side:
- Can you share a pricing option that is tied to the launch milestone (one-time uplift + milestone discount)?
- Can Redwood co-term the uplift to our existing Jan 2027 contract end?
- We may need executive approval for anything over a 20% discount — can you advise the approver path and a target turnaround?

Attached is our short usage forecast for Q2 so you can see the runway.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product
Cobalt Health

Attachments: Cobalt_Q2_Usage_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB)

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cobalthealth.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverable-linked upgrade request

Elena — thanks for the context and the forecast. High level we can support a deliverable-linked uplift and co-term to your Jan 2027 expiration. Below are three pragmatic paths (I kept commercial and ops tradeoffs explicit so procurement can pick):

Option A — Minimal uplift (fast)
- Add 250k committed tokens/month, prorated for remaining contract term
- No milestone discount (standard committed rate)
- No PO changes; invoice on next cycle
- Pros: fastest to implement

Option B — Staged uplift + voucher (preferred operationally)
- Add 250k committed tokens/month now, with a 6-month voucher for unused committed units to smooth launch volatility
- 12% one-time delivery discount applied to uplift bucket if milestone (production summaries ingesting >80% of expected traffic) is met within 90 days
- Requires PO amendment; legal amendment to co-term

Option C — Deliverable-linked discount (commercially attractive)
- Add 250k/month, pay Q3/Q4 upfront for committed uplift
- 18% discount on uplift while the milestone period is in effect; if you request >20% we need exec signoff (Ben/VP Sales)
- Co-term to Jan 2027, requires amendment and DocuSign

Operational asks from Redwood:
- Signed MAP (mutual action plan) with milestone criteria (I attached a draft)
- PO and procurement timeline so we can lock capacity and schedule billing changes

I’ve looped Ben and Marissa for pricing/discount approval and legal coordination. If you want to push toward >20%, tell me the contract size and any multi-year interest — that will help frame the escalation.

Next steps I propose:
1) Elena: confirm which option you prefer and your procurement ETA
2) Redwood: if Option C and >20% requested, internal approval request (Ben) by EOD Monday

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.docx

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Deliverable-linked upgrade request — discount request approval

Ben/Marissa — forwarding Elena’s ask. Key points: 250k additional committed tokens/month; customer willing to prepay Q3/Q4 for the uplift if we give a deliverable-linked discount. They asked whether exec approval is required for >20%.

Why this matters:
- They’re a referenceable healthcare customer, regulatory compliance is in scope (private deployment planning may follow if rollout is successful)
- Multi-month prepayment reduces Redwood collection risk and accelerates recognition

Commercial suggestion for approval:
- Approve up to 20% off uplift with the following constraints: upfront payment for two quarters, 12-month min on uplift, clear MAP milestone language, and legal to draft an amendment with co-term to Jan 2027. If Cobalt pushes for 22%+ then we ask for a 24-month committed extension or an additional professional services tranche (paid) to offset margin.

I ran a quick sensitivity (attached) showing margin impact and suggested fallback levers (voucher, seat swap, multi-year). If you’re okay with 20% we can respond to Elena with an approval and instruct legal to prepare an amendment + DocuSign.

Thanks — attaching my analysis.

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the forecast. We’ve reviewed internally and can move forward with a commercial path that balances the launch risk and your timeline. Summary of what we can approve today: 

Approved commercial path (subject to amendment signing):
- Uplift: +250k committed tokens/month, co-term to Jan 31, 2027
- Pricing: 20% discount on the uplift bucket while the milestone period is in effect
- Payment: Upfront payment for Q3/Q4 uplift (invoice upon amendment signature)
- Minimum term: 12 months on the uplift bucket

If Cobalt needs >20% we are prepared to consider 22% with at least one of the following: multi-year extension (24 months) or an additional paid services engagement to offset the RPM.

Next operational steps:
1) Legal (cc’d) will draft an amendment co-terming the uplift to Jan 31, 2027 and include the MAP language for milestone acceptance criteria.
2) I’ll seed a DocuSign envelope (link below) once legal posts the amendment. Please confirm signer and procurement contact for execution.
